Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Boulder Colorado hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the October 3, 2026 snapshot, at 12 of the 18 Boulder Colorado hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: trivago DEALS at 4, Vio.com at 3, A-Lodge Boulder at 1, Booking.com at 1, Kiwi.com at 1, the hotel's own site at 1 and Traveluro at 1. These are the Boulder Colorado rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at Boulder Colorado hotels

At the 14 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 14% ($20 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 6% at A-Lodge Boulder (Boulder Adventure Lodge) to 15% at Comfort Inn & Suites Boulder. At 4 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
